status_summary: No presidential commission or select congressional committee on COVID-19 origins, costs and possible damages from China was found, and no 119th Congress bill creating one was found. The White House replaced its COVID-19 pages on 2025-04-18 with a page presenting a lab-leak explanation of the virus's origins, which announces no commission and seeks no damages. The Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee, a standing committee, released subpoenas to 14 U.S. agencies on 2025-01-27 about origins and gain-of-function research. Separately, a federal district judge entered a default judgment of about 24.5 billion dollars against China on 2025-03-07 in a suit brought by Missouri's attorney general, a state action rather than a federal one.
